This project proposes a smart, digital OPD Queue Management Platform that provides real-time queue visibility, digital token generation, priority handling for elderly and emergency patients, and efficient doctor-side queue control. The platform aims to reduce waiting time, improve hospital workflow, and enhance patient satisfaction by introducing transparency, automation, and scalability into the OPD process.
